title: Concept: Unescaped HTML sink Phoenix.HTML.raw (elixir) — review required
description: In elixir, Phoenix.HTML.raw inserts raw markup into a page. Unescaped sinks turn stored or reflected input into script execution in the victim's session. The elixir-specific remedy is contextual escaping via Phoenix.HTML.html_escape.
applicability: elixir codebases rendering values through Phoenix.HTML.raw; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Stored or reflected cross-site scripting when untrusted input reaches the sink; MEDIUM severity, HIGH for stored sinks on authenticated pages.
